hero.body: HUMA develops human capabilities that help people communicate, lead, adapt, and act more effectively in a changing world.
hero.subtitle: Customized organizational learning around Presence, Resilience, Adaptability, and Leadership.

panel.title: From organizational challenge to human capability.
panel.body: A site built around movement, clarity, and the ability to act. Not another off-the-shelf workshop, but capability development tailored to the organizational challenge.

context.title: The world is changing. People need new capabilities to move with it.

body.paragraph1: Technology is changing. Roles are changing. Teams are changing. Behind every shift are people who need to know how to adapt, communicate, lead, and act even when reality keeps moving.
body.paragraph2: The challenge is not only knowing what to do. The challenge is being capable of doing it in practice.

insightPreview.title: Six short questions that help us identify your organization's current leverage point.
insightPreview.body: Every organization faces different challenges. Answer six short questions and we will understand together where your main leverage point sits right now and what can help you move forward.

capabilitiesSection.title: One human advantage.
capabilitiesSection.body: The capability we develop is the center. The format changes according to the need.

presence.label: PRESENCE
presence.title: Take your place. Create influence.
presence.description: Presence, confidence, communication, influence, leadership, and the embodied voice and language that help people be felt.

resilience.label: RESILIENCE
resilience.title: Adapt. Recover. Keep moving.
resilience.description: Coping with change, pressure, workload, and uncertainty while preserving flexibility and the ability to act.

adaptability.label: ADAPTABILITY
adaptability.title: Move with change. Adjust.
adaptability.description: Mental flexibility, adopting new patterns, and acting effectively inside a changing reality.

leadership.label: LEADERSHIP
leadership.title: Lead. From connection.
leadership.description: Leading teams, mobilizing people, managing energy, and making decisions in conditions of uncertainty.

processSection.title: The solution does not begin by choosing a workshop. It begins by understanding the need.
processSection.body: We begin with your need, and build from there.

discover.title: We understand the challenge.
discover.description: We get to know the organization, the people, the needs, and the goals.
discover.outcome: Output: a map of needs and goals

design.title: We shape the response.
design.description: We tailor the content, structure, format, and learning experience.

act.title: We turn learning into capability.
act.description: People practice, gain tools, and connect them directly to the world of work.

challengesSection.eyebrow: You have a challenge. We begin there.
challengesSection.title: You do not need another workshop. You need the right response to your challenge.
challengesSection.body: Choose the statement that is closest to what is happening in your organization. HUMA's direction becomes clear according to the challenge, not according to an off-the-shelf product.

leadThroughChange.statement: Our managers need to lead through a period of change.
leadThroughChange.direction: Develop managerial presence, team resilience, and practical tools for leading through uncertainty.

initiativeAndVoice.statement: Our people need to bring more initiative and a stronger voice.
initiativeAndVoice.direction: Strengthen Presence, build confidence in communication, and create an environment that allows real influence.

loadAndUncertainty.statement: Our teams are coping with overload and uncertainty.
loadAndUncertainty.direction: Build Resilience, give people tools for faster recovery, and support energy and focus under load.

communicationAndCollaboration.statement: We want to strengthen communication, connection, and collaboration.
communicationAndCollaboration.direction: Develop a shared organizational language, stronger interpersonal communication, and more effective work together.

formatsSection.eyebrow: How could this look in your organization?
formatsSection.title: The format changes according to the need. The capability we develop stays at the center.

outcomesSection.title: Outcomes that are felt in practice, not only a learning experience.

relevance.label: RELEVANCE
relevance.title: Content that is tailored to your reality.

practicalTools.label: PRACTICAL TOOLS
practicalTools.title: Tools people can take directly into the work itself.

experience.label: EXPERIENCE
experience.title: Learning through practice, not only through listening.

application.label: APPLICATION
application.title: A clear connection between development and day-to-day behavior.

adaptability.label: ADAPTABILITY
adaptability.title: A stronger ability to deal with change.

impact.label: IMPACT
impact.title: Capability development that continues to serve the organization over time.

contactSection.title: Tell us a little about the organization, the people, and the challenge you are working with.
contactSection.body: We will get to know the situation, map the need, and think together about what truly fits. You do not need another workshop. You need the right response to your challenge.
